summary: A flat paragraph For every loop without an inline body or indented block is rejected with a located Lowering error.
A phrase expression used directly as another phrase argument is not recursively phrase-resolved; bind it with Let first.
Very long fixed English sentences fall back to a clean Unsupported verdict instead of crashing Link Grammar.
The editor parity runner has a 10,000,000-step reference-interpreter budget; oversize runs return a structured failure, not a panic.
StrMap stores caller-owned TcString pointers; keys must outlive the map. IntMap and StrMap grow beyond 256 entries.
A bare identifier that is also an open-class VerbNet verb can be read as a verb in an arithmetic expression; it fails loudly. Declare the value with Let or choose an unambiguous identifier.

Parenthesized expression nesting is capped at 32 groups. Depth 33 or greater returns a located depth-limit error before recursive parsing can exhaust the Rust stack, including on the smaller test-thread stack.
behavior: clean expression nesting exceeds the Core-7 limit
